outcome_class_rationale: Moody's downgraded UC Health (OH) twice within the window: A3 → Baa2 (Feb 2023, two-notch), then Baa2 → Baa3 (May 2023, one-notch) — total three notches. S&P downgraded twice: A → BBB+ (Feb 2023) and BBB+ → BBB (March 2024) — total two notches. Per schema, MULTI_DOWNGRADE = two-or-more notch down by any agency. UC Health Cincinnati is the textbook MULTI_DOWNGRADE in this universe (DSCR -2.66 in FY23 noted in obligor list).
